findings.title: Territory summary
findings.message: 18 intervals on 7 chromosomes, covering 5,646 bp after merging overlaps. Sizes: smallest 231 bp, median 300 bp, largest 700 bp. chrY absent; chrM present.
findings.fix: No action needed. Check that the totals match what you expect for your design (for example, the panel or exome you ordered).
findings.detail: Counts intervals, total and merged base pairs, the size distribution, intervals on alt/decoy/unplaced contigs (any name that is not chr1-22, X, Y or M, with or without 'chr'), presence of chrY and chrM, and the number of header lines that were ignored.
